entry.title: RT John Kraus: This Super Heavy booster flies again tomorrow. It is the first booster reuse of the Starship program, and comes after just eight prior ...
entry.summary: RT John Kraus This Super Heavy booster flies again tomorrow. It is the first booster reuse of the Starship program, and comes after just eight prior flights. Falcon 9 took until flight 32 to see a booster reuse. That turnaround was almost a year — this turnaround is ~4 months. Significant.
